name: exchange-rates-mcp-server
description: Convert currencies, get FX rates, and query historical Frankfurter v1 exchange rate data via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Convert currencies, get FX rates, and query historical Frankfurter v1 exchange rate data.
interface.longDescription: Daily FX rates and currency conversion from Frankfurter v1, with current currency discovery and date-aware historical coverage from 1999-01-04. Includes local EUR cross-rates, full-range time-series summaries, and DataCanvas SQL analytics.
